review.body:
<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=2 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 2 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — Both functions return {whole, segments, markersUsed, markersIgnored}. open.test.ts covers 0/1/2/3 markers, a peak on either side of a marker and an empty segment.
- A2: met — Literal transition lists and expected values. Hand-checked: mixed periods give 14.545 / 75%, and tooDeep is capped at 100.
- A3: met — The fixture gives 12/12/20 breaths. Whole-session values check out by hand: 14.667, 6.818, 13.636, 72.727.
- A4: unverified — Tier A end-to-end and Tier B tests are present with one shared seed and noise setting. Whether noisy refinement stays within ±0.3 / ±0.1 s depends on the test run.
- A5: unverified — Config reads, the depthIndexCapPct key with its test, and the index re-export are present. Lint, typecheck and test results were not available to review.
- A6: met — open-edges.test.ts covers every listed edge, including the non-representable periods and the ±100 cap, using bandEdgeEpsilon.
- A7: met — The new key, the refine tests, and the unrefined I:E < 1.9 check are present, and transitions.ts is untouched. The window rounding defect applies only at sample rates other than 20 Hz.
- A8: met — One dated, PROVISIONAL row: quotes l.15 and l.16, gives both readings, 1.81 vs 2.0, and the paced divergence. No other PLAN.md text changes.

<details><summary>4 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- Refine window can reach past ±0.25 s because Math.round rounds the half-sample up `src/lib/analysis/open.ts:189` _(downgraded: no reproduction confirmed: A7's text, the ±0.25 s rule, the value of FIXED_CONSTANTS.transitionRefineWindowS and which rates assertSampleRateHz accepts are not in the given text, so 10 Hz giving a 3-sample window cannot be shown to break a stated criterion.)_ — Use Math.floor(FIXED_CONSTANTS.transitionRefineWindowS * sampleRateHz + FIXED_CONSTANTS.bandEdgeEpsilon) so the window never exceeds 0.25 s.
- An out-of-range marker that would be ignored still throws `src/lib/analysis/open.ts:161` — Run the range check on markersUsed only, or drop non-finite and out-of-range extras into markersIgnored.
- Band-edge check reimplements paced.ts's epsilon pattern inline `src/lib/analysis/open.ts:75` — Reuse or extract the paced.ts edge helper for insideBand and the cap.
- Refined transitions can collide or reorder `src/lib/analysis/open.ts:200` — Optionally keep each refined index between its neighbours' detected indices.

</details>

_claude-opus-5-5 · 2 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: Refine window can reach past ±0.25 s because Math.round rounds the half-sample up
suggestions.detail: reach = Math.round(transitionRefineWindowS * sampleRateHz). When 0.25 × fs ends in .5, the window grows by one sample beyond 0.25 s. At 10 Hz, round(2.5) = 3 samples, which is 0.30 s. At 30 Hz, round(7.5) = 8 samples, which is 0.267 s. analyzeOpen accepts any sampleRateHz that passes assertSampleRateHz. At those rates it can move a transition to a raw extremum outside the ±0.25 s window that A7 and the PLAN.md decision both state. The tests only use 20 Hz, where 0.25 × 20 = 5 is exact, so they don't catch this.
suggestions.repro: refineTransitions(raw, 10, [{index: 20, t: 2, type: 'peak', level: 0}]) with raw = 40 zeros and raw[23] = 5. It returns index 23 (t = 2.3 s, 0.3 s from the detected time). It should keep index 20.
suggestions.fix: Use Math.floor(FIXED_CONSTANTS.transitionRefineWindowS * sampleRateHz + FIXED_CONSTANTS.bandEdgeEpsilon) so the window never exceeds 0.25 s.
suggestions.downgraded: no reproduction confirmed: A7's text, the ±0.25 s rule, the value of FIXED_CONSTANTS.transitionRefineWindowS and which rates assertSampleRateHz accepts are not in the given text, so 10 Hz giving a 3-sample window cannot be shown to break a stated criterion.

suggestions.title: An out-of-range marker that would be ignored still throws
suggestions.detail: Markers are range-checked before the slice to the first 2. A legacy third marker past the session end raises a RangeError for the whole session instead of being ignored and counted. Consider validating only markersUsed, or counting invalid extras in markersIgnored.
suggestions.repro: openMetrics(t, {durationS: 18, markersS: [4.5, 9, 25]}) throws instead of returning markersIgnored: 1.
suggestions.fix: Run the range check on markersUsed only, or drop non-finite and out-of-range extras into markersIgnored.

suggestions.title: Band-edge check reimplements paced.ts's epsilon pattern inline
suggestions.detail: The card names floorAtEdge in paced.ts as the pattern to follow. insideBand and the depthIndex cap use bandEdgeEpsilon correctly but duplicate that logic. A shared helper would keep open and paced consistent.
suggestions.fix: Reuse or extract the paced.ts edge helper for insideBand and the cap.

suggestions.title: Refined transitions can collide or reorder
suggestions.detail: Adjacent same-type windows can share a sample, and a peak can move past a nearby trough. After the sort by index, the sequence then stops alternating and openBreaths silently drops those breaths. This is noise-dependent and not shown by the current fixtures.
suggestions.fix: Optionally keep each refined index between its neighbours' detected indices.
